title: Answered but not yet filed questions sink below open ones and fold, and the page gets sections past Blocking and Whenever
why: Owner ask ask-mw18jkyan1, Nov 3 16:04 CST, claude-settings Cockpit: 'Questions that are answered and green but aren't yet filed, need to also fall down and collapse ... is there just whenever and blocked? there needs more sections i think'.
note: Departs from: skill waiting-page, an answered item stays in place with a green edge until its owner closes it, in tiers Blocking, Upcoming, Whenever and Pick stands. Change: an item with answers/<id> and no filed receipt moves to its own section below the open tiers, folded to its title and answer, and the designer proposes what other sections the owner needs (for example, by repo for the child-repo audit items). Builds on page-stale-asks-sink (#997), which folds seen unanswered items. Port: no; page.html, every repo's page on its next republish. Screen lane: designer first, design reviewer after. Done check: a page with one answered-unfiled item and one open item in a tier shows the open one first and the answered one in its section, folded, at every size and theme. Needs no answer. Ready.
